definitions.explanation: The capital city of Japan, located in the Kanto region.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいます→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
{東京|とうきょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{首都|しゅと}→首都：03224_shuto⟧です。
examples.english: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧、{東京|とうきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: I plan to go to Tokyo next week.

notes:
{東京|とうきょう} literally means "eastern capital" (⟦{東|ひがし}→東：02250_higashi⟧ east + {京|きょう} capital). It became the capital when the emperor moved from ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧ (Kyoto, "capital city") in 1868.

ADMINISTRATIVE TERMS:
- {東京都|とうきょうと}: Tokyo Metropolis (official name; unique administrative status, not a ⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧)
- ⟦{都内|とない}→都内：19144_tonai⟧: within Tokyo (used like "in Tokyo" for urban areas)
- ⟦{都心|としん}→都心：04072_toshin⟧: central Tokyo (the core business/government area)
- ⟦{首都圏|しゅとけん}→首都圏：18485_shutoken⟧: Greater Tokyo Area (includes surrounding prefectures)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {東京|とうきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live in Tokyo
- {東京|とうきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to Tokyo
- {東京|とうきょう}⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧: from Tokyo

USAGE:
Informally, {東京|とうきょう} often refers specifically to the 23 special wards (⟦{特別区|とくべつく}→特別区：28159_tokubetsuku⟧), while {東京都|とうきょうと} includes western suburban areas as well.
